description: LoomDesk's book: protocol-owned liquidity, one full-range LOOM/WETH position in LoomDesk's own Uniswap v4 pool, whose hook (LoomPairsHookV2) takes every fee in WETH and charges a swap that closes a wide gap to the market. Its value, positions, fees collected and earnings not yet put back. What the book earns buys LOOM back into its pool; LOOM is never sold and nothing is paid to holders (payouts ended 24 September 2026; paidToHoldersUsdg is what was paid before).
